alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

tool_errors: logs: logs: /ecs/checkout: An error occurred (ResourceNotFoundException) when calling the FilterLogEvents operation: The specified log group does not exist.

root_cause.hypothesis: Alarm likely tied to stalled/lingering ECS deployment (deployments_in_flight=1 with no completion) rather than task health — task counts, CPU, memory all nominal, no failed deployments, no logs, no recent deploy entries despite in-flight deployment.
evidence: tasks_running == tasks_desired == 2, tasks_pending 0 — service capacity healthy
cpu ~0.005%, memory ~58.6% — resource usage normal, not causing alarm
deployments_in_flight 1 but RECENT DEPLOYS list empty — inconsistent, deploy not tracked/stuck
LOGS empty — no error signal captured
ruled_out: Task crash/restart loop (tasks_running matches desired, no pending)

proposal.reasoning: Tasks/CPU/mem nominal, no failed deployments, but deployments_in_flight=1 with empty recent-deploys log and no logs — data inconsistency, can't confirm stuck vs normal rollout tail. No safe automated action fits unverified state.
proposal.expected_effect: Human checks ECS console/CloudTrail for actual deployment status; alarm silenced or deploy manually completed/rolled back once confirmed.

reasons: Action is inert or advisory; no approval required.
